news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.06 (vs ₹0.028 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.06 (up from ₹0.028 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹25.3m (up ₹23.0m from FY 2025). Net income: ₹728.0k (up ₹1.06m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.9% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 73% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 21% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
